adobe.role: Architected and led engineering for Adobe's global product data and intelligence platform
adobe.narrative: Firefly, Express, Photoshop, and Content Authenticity Initiative products were brought under one shared architecture and data standard, serving roughly 30,000 engineers, product managers, and designers. The platform carried GDPR, CCPA, and DSA governance requirements, plus CAI/C2PA content provenance, as first-class engineering constraints rather than a compliance layer bolted on afterward.

silverLabs.role: Chief Architect and SVP of Engineering, Platform, for an enterprise generative AI platform
silverLabs.narrative: The core engineering problem was building deterministic control layers over a probabilistic AI system: multimodal generation and voice synthesis needed enterprise-grade consistency at production reliability. The result was a production system trusted to run at scale with predictable behavior, plus an internal Engineering OS pairing engineers with AI agents on a shared, governed workflow.

whitePaper.title: AI-IDS: the Artificial Intelligence Instruction Design Set
whitePaper.author: Haresh V. Parekh
whitePaper.venue: Proposed arXiv categories: cs.AI, cs.CL, cs.SE
whitePaper.summary: AI-IDS treats writing AI system instructions as a systems engineering discipline rather than prompt craft: eleven sections with defined semantics, a fixed execution order, and explicit precedence rules, applied the same way regardless of model. A controlled evaluation on a production media-retrieval task, 9 articles and 161 sentences across 25 repeated rounds, backs the framework: a composite consistency score of 0.360 against 0.124 for an unstructured baseline (+23.6 percentage points), a 0% operational error rate across all 25 rounds versus 2.2% for the baseline, and a drop from 17.1 to 4.1 iterations needed to reach production-grade output. A 9-configuration ablation across two model families confirmed the gain holds under every runtime setting tested, separate from decoding controls like temperature. The underlying keyword-generation system this evaluation is grounded in has run in production across 400,000+ video productions and 7.2 million+ keywords generated.
whitePaper.relevance: Directly applicable to OneTrust's AI Governance wedge: the same structural discipline that keeps an AI-native platform's own agents consistent and auditable is the discipline the platform needs to sell to customers governing their AI systems.

engineeringOS.title: Engineering OS
engineeringOS.summary: A layered standards framework covering product, data, and AI engineering under one set of principles: meta for navigating and maintaining the OS, macro for 12 non-negotiable principles and 11 quality attributes, meso for 14 domain design guides spanning API design, data strategy, database design, observability, security, testing, deployment, documentation, design systems, code conventions, team practices, the AI-IDS framework, and prose style, and micro for the implementation standards, templates, and review artifacts engineers use day to day. A 25-skill adapter sits on top for Claude Code, routing to the right domain guide at the right point in a build rather than introducing a second standard.
engineeringOS.relevance: Demonstrates the operating discipline behind the build claims in this app: every project bootstraps against the same checkpoint table, so architecture decisions are enforced at the moment code is written.

items.quote: As we finish the successful roll-out of NUJ M2, I wanted to extend my heartfelt appreciation for your heavy-weight contribution to this complex cross-team project. You were the pivot around which different surfaces revolved. Individually, you have been a superman: working round the clock and always available to resolve issues for your team and every team. The way you interact with an SVP or an individual IC, your tone doesn't change, and that truly reflects your character.

He is an incredible person who inspires and uplifts you. As a side note, independent of his product/technical competence, he is gifted with negotiating skills that have helped us save on external vendor contracts. He is one of the reasons why Adobe is such an incredible place to be.

items.quote: I have been fortunate to work with Haresh on business-critical use cases that delivered $5M in monthly incremental ARR, and we couldn't have done it without his direct contributions, guidance, and technical expertise. A core competency I have noticed in him is getting hands-on by going deep into a problem and resolving it, when his team or others across the company have struggled to. He does it with a flair that makes everyone feel involved and appreciated, a rare quality, and is the type of leader you can count on to keep a cool head under pressure while encouraging everyone around him.
